metadata.purpose: Conservative local smoke matrix for the Task 3 drift time-series pipeline.
notes: Each run uses scripts/run_matrix.py generated cfg overrides; source cfgs are not edited.
CPU output_times support writes grid_t0000.bin, grid_t0001.bin, ... plus final grid.bin.
GPU time series are documented as future multiple-final-time runs until a GPU checkpoint callback is added.
Full intended axes: hardware CPU/GPU, HLLC branch rule <=/<, FMA contraction, optimisation O2/O3/Ofast, fast-math, solver variant, and extended-time chaotic/Lyapunov-like windows.
This smoke matrix intentionally depends only on build-double/hrsc so it can dry-run or run locally without CUDA or build-matrix artefacts.
Final-state smoke only; lambda is n/a until synchronized checkpoints or multiple exact-final-time runs are available.
Full branch/fast-math/hardware axes should be expanded with build-matrix and CUDA artefacts.
Final-state smoke only; lambda is n/a until synchronized checkpoints or multiple exact-final-time runs are available.
2D smoke at reduced resolution; intended LW3 axes include CPU/GPU, branch rule, optimisation, fast-math, and extended t_end=1.0 fitting windows.
